screenshots.description: Curantis Solutions clinical app, New Patient SNF/ALF General Assessment. Left icon nav, header tabs, patient banner (James Monroe, Patient ID, DOB, Age, Palliative Patient, prognoses, allergies), Chief Complaint / History of Illness / Goals of Care work area.

Curantis Solutions IDG/Team Meeting view. Left patient list sidebar with patient name/demographics, header tabs (Visit Profile, Order Entry, Kardex, IDG Summary), main Plan of Care with Observations Over Time charts.
Curantis Solutions Interdisciplinary Team Meeting screen. Left patient roster sidebar, header tabs, Plan of Care problem/intervention list in main work area.
